svg.title: Finite filter length and coefficient precision constrain the same alias mask
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Finite filter length and coefficient precision constrain the same alias mask
Normalized sinc × Kaiser window; passband |f| ≤ 2 MHz
116 dB stop mask begins at 6 MHz
257 taps; coefficient rounding plus continuous-frequency remainder bound
F17: 81.7047 dB; F23: 114.5455 dB fails; F29: 118.0927 dB passes this model.
257-tap delay = 1 μs; full fresh history = 2 μs; neither is measured end-to-end latency.
Finite-coefficient calculations and interpolation bounds do not establish hardware behavior.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
